title: The Florence Cathedral Dome Built Without Knowing How #shorts
topic: when construction of Florence Cathedral began in 1296, its designers planned a massive dome even though no one knew how to build it. More than a century later, Filippo Brunelleschi solved the problem, and his revolutionary dome was completed in 1436.

title: Can you win chess by losing everything? #shorts
